name: Short link — shock between the links
note: Short link with the shock squeezed between the two links, in front of the seat tube. The upper link (SP to LP, about 51mm) pivots on a bracket off the front of the seat tube and drives the shock eye SE, the lower link (MP to FP, about 85mm) carries the shock's lower end SG on an arm of its own, and the rear triangle joins AX, FP and LP. The rocker (SP, LP, SE) is kept as small as the upper link allows.
